args.title: Sep 14 support-triage summary
args.body:
- Acme export docs cover resuming after disconnect and long date ranges; no failed export reported.
- Evergreen needs clarity on active developers versus invited teammates, plus an inactive-invited example; handoff entry duplicates it.
- Mercury tickets: missing invite email, unexpected role label, and stale teammate list; no shared cause.
- Atlas has a JWT clock-skew question about timestamps; handoff reports no customer-impacting incident.
